name: subject_verb_agreement
description: Select is/are using head-noun number despite an intervening noun with opposite number; matched control copies head noun.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('key','keys'),('book','books'),('dog','dogs'),('cat','cats'),('teacher','teachers'),('student','students'),('box','boxes'),('bottle','bottles'),('picture','pictures'),('chair','chairs'),('car','cars'),('tree','trees'),('house','houses'),('bird','birds'),('flower','flowers'),('window','windows'),('door','doors'),('table','tables'),('cup','cups'),('plate','plates')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a,b=random.sample(pairs,2);plural=bool(i%2);head=a[int(plural)];other=b[int(not plural)]
 sent='The '+head+' '+random.choice(['near','beside','behind','in front of'])+' the '+other+' ___ '+random.choice(['here','there','visible','missing','outside'])+'.'
 items.append({'prompt':'Fill the blank with is or are.\n'+sent+'\nAnswer:','answer':' '+('are' if plural else 'is')})
 control.append({'prompt':'Copy the first noun in this sentence.\n'+sent+'\nAnswer:','answer':' '+head})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
